text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: KV cache eviction spike + upstream 503s (alert: KV-EVICT-THROTTLE) at 07:12 UTC. Affected region: eu-west and us-east edge pools. ~3% of requests returning 503, p95 token latency +1200ms. Paging primary oncall.

Aisha: I'm on primary. quick recap: started ~07:10, saw mass evictions on cache nodes after a rolling kernel update plus higher request fanout to a single shard. Early mitigation — routed traffic away from the hot shard to warm pool at 07:18. That reduced error rate to ~0.7% but p95 still elevated.

Marco: I'm secondary and standing by. I dug into autoscaler logs and saw a burst of evictions triggered by oom_score adjustments + a config flip in /etc/runtime/conf applied at 07:05 during the kernel rollout.

Tessa: I confirmed customer impact: a handful of mid-market tenants experienced 503s on text-generation endpoints. Not a full outage but visible. CS ticket #CS-4021 opened.

Raj: Relevant traces: https://tracing.redwood/trace/0a12b3c (sample). Top error in trace is "kv: missing prefix in kv_get" followed by retry floods.

Aisha: Actions taken so far:
- rolled back the kernel config toggle on the edge fleet (07:22)
- routed 20% of traffic to dedicated warm pool (07:18) and then 100% for affected shard (07:25)
- scaled warm pool +2 nodes (07:26)
- added temporary rate-limit on tenant fanout for heavy embeddings jobs (07:30)

Marco: Observed metrics after rollbacks: 503s dropped from 3% -> 0.4%, p95 latency down ~35%. We still see elevated cache miss rate on a subset of shards. Suspect KV compaction schedule + the kernel change interaction.

Aisha: Runbook references: KV eviction runbook (internal): <https://runbooks.internal/kv-eviction>. Short commands used:
```
# route traffic away from shard-17
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://router.api/redwood/reroute -d '{"shard":"shard-17","target":"warm-pool-eu-2","fraction":1.0}'
# scale warm pool
./infractl scale pool warm-pool-eu-2 --add 2
```

Tessa: Customer comms note (draft): "We're seeing intermittent 503s earlier this morning due to a backend cache eviction incident. We've mitigated impact by routing requests and rolling back a recent config. Engineering is monitoring and will follow up with a root cause update."

Raj: Outstanding items before handoff:
- confirm compaction window won't re-trigger (ops task assigned to infra team, ETA 10:00 UTC)
- verify warm pool memory pressure stable (watching for 30m)
- prepare a short postmortem skeleton (I'll start timeline)

Aisha: Coverage and next shift notes:
- Primary: Aisha (until 11:00 UTC)
- Secondary: Marco (on-call until 11:00 UTC)
- Swing: Tessa will monitor customer comms and CS bridge until 09:00 UTC
- Coverage gap: No APAC overlap for primary between 02:00-06:00 PDT (we need to ensure rotation tomorrow or call in oncall backup if issues re-escalate).

Marco: If anything re-escalates, escalate to eng-sre and ping @pagerduty. If we see >1% 503s again, fail traffic to dedicated fallback region (runbook step 4).

ops-bot: Deploy note: a revert was pushed by deploy-bot at 07:22 UTC (deploy id: deploy-2026-07b2). See logs: https://deploys.redwood/deploy-2026-07b2

Aisha: Handoff checklist for incoming oncall:
- Confirm error rate is <=0.5% for 30m
- Keep warm pool scaled until compaction window validated
- Watch KV eviction metric: kv.evictions_per_minute on shard-17 and neighbors
- Ensure CS ticket updated with ETA and postmortem link

Tessa: I'll update the CS ticket and the internal incident channel. Drafting PM note now.

Raj: I'm starting the postmortem timeline doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/KV-2026-eviction-draft - will add root cause hypothesis by EOD.

Aisha: Quick status now (07:50 UTC): 503s ~0.3%, p95 latency trending down. Marking incident as "mitigated" but not resolved. If no regressions by 10:00 UTC we can close the incident and convert to postmortem.

Marco: leaving this thread for handoff. Ping me if you need a rollback or if eviction spikes above 2/min/shard.

Aisha: Thanks team — handing off to next primary on rotation. Leaving bridge open for 30 min then closing. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: please attach any follow-up changelists to the postmortem and set labels: [incident][kv-eviction][priority-medium].
